node.title: b2b near tail bound
node.statement: Lemmas 8-9 + Theorem 10 (verified, exact arithmetic): by degree-(k-1) interpolation, N_{t+k} <= C(n,k)/C(t+k,k) < 2^{8k} at official parameters; both near-tails (15 layers above t and their complements) together contribute < 2^122 — half the n^3 budget, unconditionally. | SCOPE CAVEAT (2026-07-10, I5 of the 3C extraction): the proof is at the rate-1/2 row (t = 2^33+1; replayed 2^121.006, and 2^120.998 at t* = 8592912739); the bound FAILS at lower-rate t* values (exact: 2^125.4 / 2^133.9 / 2^144.2 at rates 1/4 / 1/8 / 1/16) — harmless because those rows admit no field under |F| < 2^256 (they fail sub-balance), but the 'at official parameters' wording overreached.
